4. Crypto only, big gaps only, no Claude
5. Same, with fresh prices (stale-price bug fixed)

tips: Winning about as often as Kalshi's prices expected. So far that means no skill and no edge (it's like betting at random).
Fees alone cost $20.85. That's 100% of the loss.
Doing best: Ethereum (+13.34), XRP (+5.06), Copper (+3.60). Small samples, so this could still be luck.
Doing worst: WTI oil (-3.21), Platinum (-6.99), Solana (-7.54).
Claude was too sure of itself: it expected 23.7 wins, but only 17 happened.
When the bot's math and Kalshi strongly disagreed, Kalshi was right 1089 times and the bot 702 times.
